entities.summary: Alberta Brianti is a former professional tennis player from Italy. On 13 June 2011, Brianti achieved her career-high singles ranking of 55. On 13 February 2012, she peaked at No. 68 in the doubles rankings. She won one singles title on the WTA Tour defeating Simona Halep in her career, at Fes, Morocco in 2011. Alberta Brianti was a athletes & competitors from San Secondo Parmense (b. 1980-04-05, San Secondo Parmense). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
